# Aid

> > Aid specializes in sustainable acoustic solutions, architectural cladding systems, and eco-friendly building materials with a focus on environmental certifications like EPD, FSC, and LEED compliance.

Aid provides innovative architectural products including the Ligkt stretch ceiling system, Fabrix acoustic panels, and sustainable facade solutions. The company emphasizes green building standards, lifecycle analysis (LCA), and environmental product declarations (EPD) aligned with ISO 14025 and EN 15804 for architects and construction professionals.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Product Declarations (EPD)
- ISO 14025 & EN 15804 standards
- Lifecycle Analysis (LCA)
- FSC Chain of Custody certification
- LEED & BREEAM green building certifications
- Acoustic panels & sound absorption
- Sustainable facade systems
- Low-VOC & fire-resistant materials
- Electrochromic glass & smart facades
- Biophilic design & natural materials
- Building Management Systems (BMS)
- Recycled PET & eco-friendly materials
- EN 13501-1 fire safety compliance
- Energy efficiency in building design
- Ligkt stretch ceiling systems

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Ligkt | Innovative LED & Architectural Ceilings](https://aid.co/ligkt): Ligkt stretch ceiling system with LED integration & acoustic features
- [A Place of Worship | Sustainable Acoustic Builders](https://aid.co/place-of-worship): BRMC Singapore worship space with Fabrix ML27S acoustic design solutions

## Environmental Certifications & Standards

- [Understanding Environmental Product Declarations (EPD) in Construction](https://aid.co/understanding-environmental-product-declarations-epd-in-construction): EPD fundamentals, ISO 14025 standards & LCA in sustainable construction
- [AI and Lifecycle Analysis: Automating EPD Generation in Cladding Materials](https://aid.co/ai-and-lifecycle-analysis-automating-epd-generation-in-cladding-materials): AI automation for EPD generation & LCA compliance in cladding materials
- [Environmental Product Declarations and Their Role in Project Bidding](https://aid.co/environmental-product-declarations-and-their-role-in-project-bidding): How EPDs influence project bids in LEED & green building certifications
- [FSC® Chain of Custody in Timber Acoustics: Why It Matters for Architects](https://aid.co/fsc-chain-of-custody-in-timber-acoustics-why-it-matters-for-architects): FSC certification importance for LEED, BREEAM & sustainable timber acoustics
- [Declare Red List Free: Promoting Healthier Building Environments](https://aid.co/declare-red-list-free-promoting-healthier-building-environments): ILFI Declare program & Red List Free certification for healthier buildings

## Facade & Cladding Systems

- [Smart Facade Systems: Reducing Energy Costs Through Advanced Cladding](https://aid.co/smart-facade-systems-reducing-energy-costs-through-advanced-cladding): Smart facades with electrochromic glass & BMS integration for energy savings
- [Fire-Resistant Materials: Ensuring Safety in High-Performance Facades](https://aid.co/fire-resistant-materials-ensuring-safety-in-high-performance-facades): Fire safety in facades: NFPA 285 & EN 13501-1 compliant materials
- [Innovations in Eco-Friendly Facade Systems for Urban Environments](https://aid.co/innovations-in-eco-friendly-facade-systems-for-urban-environments): Living walls, photovoltaic cladding & smog-eating facades for urban buildings
